ticket.title: Implement dual-band ADS-R cross-band deduplication
ticket.description: Implement dual-band ADS-R cross-band deduplication per SPEC Invariant 10: direct reception always wins; re-broadcast updates within Δt ≤ 1.0s and Δd ≤ 0.001° are deduplicated.
acceptance_criteria: Direct-reception updates always win and are unconditionally applied to tracks
Rebroadcast updates arriving within Δt ≤ 1.0s and Δd ≤ 0.001° of recent direct reception are deduplicated and suppressed
Rebroadcast updates outside the spatio-temporal window (Δt > 1.0s or Δd > 0.001°) are admitted and update track state
Unit and integration tests prove cross-band deduplication and boundary conditions
